rationale: Shifting the exponent of P from (a-1) to a changes the Beta distribution PDF by an index shift of 1 in the lower bound sense (the standard Beta PDF is P^{a-1}(1-P)^{b-1}/B(a,b); replacing a-1 with a is equivalent to using a+1 in place of a throughout, altering the posterior's mode and credible intervals), producing an incorrect posterior that a Wolfram FullSimplify check on the normalization integral from 0 to 1 would find inconclusive given the parametric form.
ground_truth_description: In the Beta distribution PDF used to model the posterior of cold Jupiter conditional frequency, the exponent of P was changed from (a-1) to a, shifting the effective shape parameter by 1 and making the distribution no longer the standard Beta(a,b) density.
